stories.summary: AFI has become the first real estate developer in Romania to achieve LEED Zero Carbon certification for its operational office portfolio. The certification covers seven projects and confirms a net zero balance for carbon emissions associated with energy use and occupant transportation over a one-year period.

stories.title: Study suggests AI data centres may cool surroundings
stories.summary: New satellite research challenges the idea that AI data centres create heat islands, finding limited nighttime warming and cooler daytime ground temperatures around facilities in Japan. Previous research suggested these sites could raise local temperatures significantly. The environment is now being asked to behave differently than expected.

stories.summary: India is exploring a plan to replace ageing, smaller wind turbines with larger, more efficient machines to increase generation at existing sites without acquiring additional land. The industry association estimates that 5 to 8 GW of capacity could be repowered immediately, raising output by nearly 50 percent.
